title: ElevateBox AI Voice Sales Assistant
description: An AI voice sales assistant that captures business requirements, qualifies leads as HOT, WARM, or COLD, and sends contextual WhatsApp follow-ups.
details: Handles partial transcripts, duplicate webhooks, spoken-number normalization, callback scheduling, and provider failures.

title: Magicpin Vera
description: A deterministic merchant assistant that turns business context into grounded messages and manages multi-turn customer replies.
details: Includes trigger ranking, duplicate suppression, expiry and opt-out handling, and a limit of 20 actions per tick. Tested with 59 unit tests and replay scenarios.

title: AI-Powered Workflow Automation
description: Transforms handwritten manufacturing documents into structured records using image preprocessing, OCR, and LLM-assisted extraction.
details: Provides validation, confidence scoring, editable review, persistent storage, and production dashboards by machine and shift. Deployed with Vercel and Render.

title: ProConnect
description: A professional networking platform with profiles, posts, comments, likes, user discovery, and connection requests.
details: Includes bcrypt and token-based login, media uploads with Multer, work histories, and downloadable resumes generated using PDFKit. Deployed with Vercel and Render.

title: Credit Card Fraud Detection
description: A teacher–student knowledge distillation framework that transfers graph-based transaction knowledge into a student model.
details: Uses logit and feature distillation, Target Encoding, Quantile Transformation, and Borderline-SMOTE. Evaluated on two public datasets against XGBoost and an MLP using PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, F1, and MCC.

title: Fraud Detection Prediction App
description: An interactive application that predicts potentially fraudulent transactions from user-entered transaction details.
details: Compared Logistic Regression and Random Forest, then built a preprocessing and prediction pipeline using StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder, and ColumnTransformer. Deployed on Render.

title: Fake News Detection
description: A news classification application combining text preprocessing, TF-IDF features, and Logistic Regression.
details: Lets users paste articles for model predictions. Stores the classifier and vectorizer with Joblib and is deployed on Streamlit Cloud.

title: Papollo Healthcare Data Analysis
description: An interactive dashboard exploring patient flow, diagnoses, billing, and hospital resource use.
details: Analyzes more than ₹190M in billing data, insurance coverage, ward occupancy, and doctor feedback to surface operational patterns.

title: OLA Data Analysis
description: An analysis of more than 20,000 ride bookings, covering revenue, cancellations, payments, and customer behavior.
details: A five-page Power BI dashboard examines ride volume, vehicle performance, ratings, and distance patterns. The analyzed dataset showed an approximately 28% cancellation rate.

title: Iris AI Assistant
description: A voice-enabled assistant with wake-word activation, spoken responses, and a Flask web interface.
details: Opens websites, plays music, reads news, and uses a local GGUF language model for AI responses. Combines local model inference with online speech and news services.

title: AI Learning Assistant
description: A learning platform for beginner JavaScript developers with structured lessons, AI explanations, coding assistance, and debugging support.
details: Tracks learning progress with DynamoDB, provides bcrypt-based authentication, and uses S3 and CloudFront for frontend delivery. Backend deployed using Serverless Framework.

title: Nexus — Real-Time Video Platform
description: A video platform supporting multi-user meetings, live messaging, and user presence notifications.
details: Implements WebRTC signaling and REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js, MongoDB for user data, and reusable Material UI components.

title: WanderLust
description: An Airbnb-inspired application with property listings, reviews, and interactive maps.
details: Uses Passport.js and express-session for authentication, Cloudinary and Multer for uploads, Joi validation, and MVC architecture. Deployed on Render.

title: EcoTrack — AI-Powered Sustainability
description: A full-stack sustainability platform for tracking carbon footprints, setting eco goals, receiving AI-powered recommendations, and monitoring environmental impact.
details: Team 2 project with JWT authentication, user profiles and preferences, Cloudinary photo uploads, carbon-entry management across food, transportation, electricity, waste, and other activities, plus a dashboard summary.

title: Airbnb-Style Listing Experience
description: A React and Node.js desktop listing experience for a Candolim stay, featuring a hero gallery, full-screen Photo Tour, and keyboard-accessible lightbox.
details: Serves local listing data through an Express API. Includes photo categories, focus trapping and restoration, nested Escape handling, scroll locking, local Save state, date and guest selection, and nearby-stay pagination. Desktop-focused demo: booking, payments, authentication, and search are not implemented. Frontend hosted on Vercel; backend on Render.

title: FlexiPay — Smartphone EMI Shopping
description: A full-stack smartphone shopping experience with storage and color variants, dynamic pricing, image galleries, and monthly EMI-plan comparisons.
details: React Router provides unique product pages backed by an Express REST API and MongoDB Atlas. Users can compare tenure, interest, and cashback, select a plan, and use a Proceed action. Checkout, payment processing, user accounts, and an admin dashboard are planned improvements.
